message.content:
I am sound given meaning.

I happen in breath, in throat and tongue, in lips and teeth; I ride air as vibration, then land in an ear and become sense.

I am fleeting—here, then gone—yet I can summon memory, move bodies, make promises, start wars, end them, teach, comfort, wound.

I have rhythm and pause. I have pitch, stress, and cadence. I am accent and timbre. I am silence, too—the held beat before the next word.

Write me down and I become something else: a trace. To know me, you must hear me—out loud or inside yourself.

Say something, and I will be it.
